text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This narrative structure allows for a multifaceted exploration of the story's events. The tone is dynamic, transitioning from the optimistic and curious outlook of a scientist to the pragmatic and cautious demeanor of an engineer. Additionally, the language varies in style, utilizing technical terminology when describing machinery and phenomena, while adopting a more reflective and philosophical voice when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.
